claims.claim: Eligibility requires an assessed primary health need.
claims.quote: People over 18 years of age who have been assessed as having a ’primary health need’ are entitled to NHS continuing healthcare.
claims.note: The leaflet states the primary health need assessment criterion.

claims.claim: The primary health need must be assessed as complex, intense, or unpredictable.
claims.quote: The team will look at all your care needs and relate them to: what help you need how complex your needs are how intense your needs can be how unpredictable they are
claims.note: These are assessment factors, but the text does not make any one of them a standalone mandatory condition.

claims.claim: A progressive serious illness is usual for eligibility.
claims.note: The sources do not say progressive serious illness is usual among eligible people.

claims.claim: A terminal condition is usual for eligibility.
claims.note: The sources discuss urgent fast-track assessment for some terminal conditions but do not say they are usual.

claims.claim: A severe disability is usual for eligibility.
claims.note: The sources do not say severe disability is usual among eligible people.
